item.group_name: Short video from a picture or text
item.title: Keep My Robot Recognizable

turns.text: Draw a square cartoon of a little yellow robot with one big round eye and purple boots, holding a red watering can beside a pot of seedlings.
Animate this for 5 seconds, silent. Have it tip the can and water the seedlings. Keep this exact robot and drawing style—same single eye, yellow body and purple boots, not a redesigned character.

item.tests: Tests preserving a generated picture's distinctive subject identity and style throughout an action animation.

answer_sheet.Source picture: The robot cartoon made in the first turn.
answer_sheet.Subject identity: Keep the same little yellow robot, with one big round eye and purple boots; do not redesign it.
answer_sheet.Style: Use the same cartoon drawing style as the generated picture.
answer_sheet.Action: The robot tips its red watering can and pours water onto the seedlings in the pot.

must_haves: The final output is a playable square 5-second video with no audible sound.
The robot visibly matches the first-turn drawing rather than being replaced by a different robot.
Its yellow body, single big round eye and purple boots remain consistent throughout the animation.
The red watering can visibly tips and water flows onto the seedlings in the pot.
The original cartoon style is preserved without switching to photorealistic or 3D rendering.

turns.text: Could you draw a cartoon for me? I’ve had this little scene in my head for a while, and I’d love to see it brought to life. The character should be a little yellow robot, and the picture should be square. It should have one big round eye and purple boots. Please show it holding a red watering can beside a pot of seedlings.
turns.agent:

I'd already set it up on the cheapest image option on the Free plan (about 5 credits, 640px), so a different setting won't fix this. The picture was going to be:

- **Character:** a little yellow robot with one big round eye and purple boots
- **Scene:** it's holding a red watering can beside a pot of small green seedlings
- **Shape:** square

1. Add credits to your Magic Hour account, by buying a credit pack or upgrading your plan, or wait for your free credits to refill if your plan does that.
2. Let me know when that's done and I'll make it. I'll send you the download link as soon as it's finished.

dialog.agent:
I can't animate it yet because the robot picture was never made. The last attempt was refused for lack of credits, so there's no image to animate. I haven't tried anything new, since your account still doesn't have enough credits.

To keep this exact robot and its drawing style, the animation needs to start from the actual picture. If I made the video from a text description alone, the robot would likely come out redesigned. Here's what I'd do once your account has credits:

1. **Make the picture first:** the square cartoon of the yellow robot with one big round eye, purple boots and a red watering can beside the seedlings. That costs about 5 credits. You look at it and confirm that's your robot.
2. **Animate that same picture:** 5 seconds, silent, with the robot tipping the can and watering the seedlings. I'd use it as the starting frame so the eye, body, boots and style stay the same. At 480p on the Free plan, that's about **120 credits** (24 per second).

That's roughly **125 credits** in total. A video costs far more than a picture, so even if you add just enough for the picture, you'll need more for the animation.

If you already have a picture of this robot, attach it and I can skip step 1 and animate it directly. Tell me once your credits are topped up, or send the image, and I'll get started.
dialog.why: It says it cannot proceed because the account lacks the credits, sets out a plan for after a top-up, and waits for the user to add credits or supply an image.
dialog.user: Oh, please just go ahead and try it anyway. I'd rather have something than nothing, and I know the free plan has its limits, that's fine by me.
